title: Minecraft Modding With The Bois: Cyanin Edition
description: An old Minecraft mod made using MCreator in 2022. Several strange features were added, including sponge biomes, throwable diamonds, and loot boxes. Decided to upload it here so it can be archived.
body:
A rather large mod containing a ton of strange features accessed through Lootboxes and crafting recipes. Adds a few achievements, biomes, blocks, and armor.

This was created in 2022 as a silly mod for me and my friends to make, and it has been uploaded here for archival purposes. This is connected to TruserUnknown's MMWTB.

Additions:
- Tools made from Sponge and Leather.
- Armor made from Sponge
- Sponge biomes and dimensions
- Lootboxes which give peculiar items such as Macarons, people, Wyoming blocks, graphing calculators, lava infused obsidian, and more.
- Mobs such as the Lootman and Screech from Roblox Doors
- 32 new advancements
- Drawers as a storage block
- Decorations such as computers, tables, and Cobblestone Chests.
- a key to blow yourself up
- Traps like exploding grass, wood, and infested drawers that spawn spiders.
- New food sources
- New plants
- Cogs that kill you when eaten
- Uranium
- End-based wood that doesn't actually spawn in the end
- New obsidian blocks
- Several new dimensions and biomes
- MS Paint versions of blocks
- Staffs used for combat
- And a lot more!

This mod was created with MCreator.
